execution_batches.description: Simplify the runtime architecture and remove phase-1-incompatible flow pieces.
Align core producer and consumer paths with the simplified architecture.
Align infrastructure and validate the core flow end-to-end through tests and build.

tasks.title: Retire orchestrator and Step Functions from phase 1 runtime path
outputs: One clearly defined runtime path for phase 1
exit_criteria: Phase 1 runtime no longer depends on orchestrator or Step Functions.
There is no ambiguity about which component consumes the FIFO queue in phase 1.

tasks.title: Unify consumer runtime entrypoint around direct queue consumption
outputs: One consumer entrypoint aligned with the phase 1 flow
exit_criteria: Consumer code exposes one clear runtime path for SQS-driven execution.
The code no longer keeps duplicate mental models for provider execution.

tasks.title: Align producer domain and adapters with phase 1 dispatch rules
outputs: Producer flow consistent with target-date processing and FIFO grouping
exit_criteria: Producer selects PENDING records for the target date.
Producer dispatches one FIFO message per eligible record.
MessageGroupId and MessageDeduplicationId match the phase 1 contract.

tasks.title: Align consumer domain and adapters with final-outcome persistence
outputs: Consumer flow consistent with success and terminal-failure persistence
exit_criteria: Consumer executes one provider request per message.
Pending-record lifecycle mutation is not introduced in phase 1.

tasks.title: Align CDK infrastructure with simplified phase 1 runtime
outputs: Infrastructure definition that matches the simplified runtime path
exit_criteria: FIFO queue points directly to consumer.
Unused phase 1 orchestration resources are removed or isolated from the runtime path.

tasks.title: Update tests and validate phase 1 core flow
outputs: Passing tests and build for the phase 1 architecture
exit_criteria: Consumer tests prove success and terminal-failure persistence.
Handler tests match the simplified runtime path.
